headline: Healthcare that takes time to *listen*.
lede: Premier Wellness Telehealth provides compassionate, HIPAA-compliant virtual care for adults across Florida, Virginia, and Washington — convenient, personalized care from the comfort and privacy of your home.
bio:
Lissette Moody, DNP, APRN-C, is a board-certified nurse practitioner and the founder of Premier Wellness Telehealth. With approximately 14 years of experience as a nurse practitioner, she has cared for adults across a variety of clinical settings, including primary care, preventive health, chronic condition support, and comprehensive wellness assessments.

She founded Premier Wellness Telehealth to provide adults with convenient access to thoughtful, personalized care without the pressure and rushed experience that can sometimes occur in traditional healthcare settings.

Her approach is centered on listening carefully, explaining recommendations clearly, and involving patients in decisions about their health.
